主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings Inc (IMH) announced that Paul Licon has assumed the role of Chief Financial Officer effective May 1, 2020. Mr. Licon, 39, has been serving as Chief Accounting Officer since May 2019 and Principal Accounting Officer since August 2019. Prior to joining Impac in April 2016, he worked as a Senior Manager at KPMG, LLP from January 2015 to April 2016 and as an auditor at Squar Milner, LLP from May 2007 to December 2014. The Company began transitioning these responsibilities to Mr. Licon when he was appointed Chief Accounting Officer on May 1, 2019.
